Dispatcher: Measured stretch so far, still here. The Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps the handoff calm and tidy.
Coordinator: Note the pet profile first, then log any crate notes and cabin needs in the ledger.
Planner: <<FACT F107>> Use that step only after the arrival details are checked and the traveler is confirmed.
Handler: Keep the language short, kind, and clear so the passenger can follow each step without stress.
Dispatcher: If the booking needs a final review, route it through the usual desk flow and keep the record clean.
Coordinator: <<FACT F091>> After that, finish the file with the travel note and the service update.
Planner: Aurelia Skyways expects the same careful tone across all skyports, so match the message to the traveler.
Handler: If Lucia Romano or Samuel Williams appears in the file, keep the notes precise and avoid extra chatter.
Dispatcher: For Pip, check comfort details and make sure the carrier plan stays consistent with the service request.
Coordinator: Confirm the handoff, record any change, and close the thread once the file reads clearly for the next shift.
